item.title: Kimi K3 Countdown: China's Next Flagship Model Takes on Claude Fable 5
item.description: Moonshot AI drops a 36-second teaser for K3 across Bilibili, X, and Xiaohongshu. With 2.5T-param MoE architecture, 1M-token context window, and Agent Swarm coordination, anonymous testing on Chatbot Arena (codename 'Kivine') shows it can go head-to-head with Claude Fable 5.
